INNER JOIN colour AS c_hair ON s."XCL_023" = c_hair."XCL_005"
INNER JOIN hero_attribute AS ha ON s."XCL_018" = ha."XCL_009"
INNER JOIN attribute AS a ON ha."XCL_010" = a."XCL_003"
WHERE (s."XCL_029" IS NULL OR s."XCL_029" = 0)
AND c_eye."XCL_006" = 'Blue'
AND c_hair."XCL_006" = 'Brown'
AND a."XCL_004" = 'Intelligence'
ORDER BY ha."XCL_011" ASC
LIMIT 1
